definition: A statement that two expressions are equal, such as $2x + 3 = 11$; solving it finds the values that make it true.
An equation in which the unknown appears only to the power $1$, such as $4(x - 3) = 2x + 5$.
Two equations with the same unknowns that must both be true at once, so you solve them together.
The letter on its own on one side of a formula, such as $A$ in $A = lw$.
An equation that can be written as $ax^{2} + bx + c = 0$ with $a \neq 0$, so $x^{2}$ is the highest power of $x$.
The formula $x = \frac{-b \pm \sqrt{b^{2} - 4ac}}{2a}$, which gives the solutions of $ax^{2} + bx + c = 0$ when $b^{2} - 4ac \ge 0$.
